 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    line_color = next((v for v in colors if v != 8 and (all(row[0] == v for row in grid) or all(x == v for x in grid[0]))), None)
    if line_color is None:
        return out
    if all(row[0] == line_color for row in grid):
        # Place a full-height 8 line immediately after the object.
        bg = max(colors - {line_color}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in (bg, line_color) for r in range(h))]
        c = max(cols) + 1
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 8
    else:
        # For a horizontal barrier, put a full-width 8 line below the object.
        bg = max(colors - {line_color}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(x not in (bg, line_color) for x in grid[r])]
        out[max(rows) + 1] = [8] * w
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
